0022600142.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West, on a four-game win streak) head to Dallas for their fifth game of the season, facing a Mavericks team at 2-2 that sits 8th in the West. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh, and Thomas Sorber, and Alex Caruso is day-to-day with an ankle injury and listed as a game-time decision. Dallas is without Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic, while Naji Marshall and Sergio de Larrea are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Thunder won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026, and no games have been played yet between the teams this season.
